content: As a Muslim, hard work is worship—*"Strive as if you’ll live forever, but prepare for death tomorrow."* Toxicity has no place in faith. **"Your sweat is sadaqah (charity); your exhaustion, a prayer. But if you burn out, who will carry your deeds?"** Balance is *ibadah* (worship). Keep going, but rest—Allah loves gentleness in all things.
